definitions.explanation: The area or boundaries within which something operates, exists, or applies.

examples.japanese: テストの{範囲|はんい}を{教|おし}えてください。
examples.english: Please tell me the scope of the test.

examples.japanese: {予算|よさん}の{範囲|はんい}で{選|えら}んでください。
examples.english: Please choose within the budget limits.
examples.notes: 〜の範囲で = within the limits of ~

examples.japanese: {影響|えいきょう}の{範囲|はんい}が{広|ひろ}がっている。
examples.english: The scope of the impact is expanding.

notes:
USAGE: {範囲|はんい} indicates boundaries, limits, or the extent of something. Very common in academic, business, and everyday contexts.

COMMON PATTERNS:
・〜の{範囲|はんい} (the scope/range of ~)
・{範囲|はんい}{内|ない} (within the range)
・{範囲|はんい}{外|がい} (outside the range)
・{範囲|はんい}を{広|ひろ}げる (to expand the scope)
・{範囲|はんい}を{限|かぎ}る (to limit the scope)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・テストの{範囲|はんい} (test coverage)
・{権限|けんげん}の{範囲|はんい} (scope of authority)
・{予算|よさん}の{範囲|はんい} (budget limits)
・{能力|のうりょく}の{範囲|はんい} (within one's ability)
・{広|ひろ}い{範囲|はんい} (wide range)
